page_topic_one_liner: Lovable-hosted embed of AI website audit tool — full-screen iframe wrapper for external audit UI
differentiator_vs_generic: Embedded Lovable audit app frame, NOT native audit UI clone alone. HERO must show browser/iframe chrome wrapping audit tool canvas with loading spinner motif.
visual_anchors: HERO: Full-screen iframe browser chrome wrapping blurred audit tool interior (URL bar visible in inner frame, report tabs hint)
Secondary: Lovable-style loading spinner overlay fading out at corner
Tertiary: embed arrow from outer Alignify frame into inner app canvas
anti_patterns: Identical static mock to audit-website with no iframe motif
